symptom: `mxcli test <dir>` prints `Found 0 test(s) in 1 file(s)` then `no tests found in the provided files`, for a directory that visibly contains a `.mdl` test
cause: Discovery matches on the file NAME (`*.test.mdl` / `*.test.md`), and nothing said so. The `1 file(s)` was the DIRECTORY counted as a path, so it read as though a file had been opened and found wanting
insight: **Count files read, not paths given** — one directory is one path and zero-to-many files. When the suite is empty, name the `.mdl`/`.md` files that were skipped for their name: a `.mdl` in a test directory is almost always the intended test misnamed, so listing it turns a dead end into a rename. Do NOT list unrelated extensions (`.txt`), and on a genuinely empty directory do NOT claim files were skipped — describe the format instead. Both branches have tests, and `FilesRead` has a positive control so it cannot pass by never being incremented. ako/mxcli-maintenance §5
